performance.verdict: $615 spent, zero conversions — tracking is broken, not the ads.

findings.text: 28 days, $614.94 Google spend, 129 clicks, zero conversions recorded — CPL is undefined because conversion tracking is not firing, not because leads aren't arriving.
GHL shows 167 contacts and 136 opportunities created at $0 value with 0 won — intake is logging contacts but no revenue or lead qualification is captured, suggesting a pipeline configuration gap.
OVERDUE SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA due 2026-07-20 is marked done but the GHL opportunity value field reads $0 across all 136 created — money path verification is unconfirmed.
3-day spend signal (Aug 27–29): $19.69, $21.62, $1.38 — spend collapsed on Aug 29, likely a daily budget exhaustion or campaign pause mid-cycle, not a strategic pause.

GBP actions fell 62.5% week-over-week; last 3 days show 6, 0, 0 actions — local visibility has stalled, contradicting the daily verdict's framing of it as 'compounding' paid; organic was already flat.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion action — 129 clicks and $614.94 spent with zero conversions recorded confirms pixel is not firing.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $614.94 over 28 days across 129 clicks with zero conversions registered — the pixel or conversion action is confirmed broken. Pull the conversion action in Google Ads, verify the tag fires on the thank-you or call-confirmed page, and cross-reference against GHL's 136 created opportunities to confirm leads are arriving. Success = at least one conversion event recorded within 72 hours of the fix. Deadline: 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Verify BWS duplicate-check and Stripe money path: run one live order through each intake path and confirm opportunity value populates above $0.
suggestions.monday_update: 136 GHL opportunities have been created with $0 value and 0 won, and the Stripe Products milestone (due 2026-07-20) remains unverified in revenue data. Run one dummy order through each intake path (WordPress/Stripe + GHL Products) and confirm exactly one opportunity is created per order with correct dollar value populated. Success = both paths show a non-zero opportunity value in GHL within 48 hours. Deadline: 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Hold all Google Ads budget scaling until conversion tracking is confirmed firing — re-check 2026-09-03 after fix.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend dropped to $1.38 on Aug 29 with the 28-day campaign still showing zero conversions — scaling now would burn budget blind. Hold all budget increases on BWS - Search Campaign - Calls until S1 tracking fix is confirmed. Re-check on 2026-09-03: if at least one conversion event is recorded and CPL is calculable, bring the scaling question back to Sohib for approval.
